Convening

Invitation-only convenings for the leaders who set the agenda.

Out Leadership summits, salons and dinners are closed-door and business-focused. Attendance is by invitation — to our member companies, their clients and their guests. Members register through the Member Portal (LOGIN above). Not yet a member? Request an invitation through our membership team, or explore fifteen years of summits around the world.
